description: US macro, energy and fiscal series: BLS (jobs, wages, prices, productivity), FRED (rates, money, GDP, PCE, jobless claims, Fed balance sheet, dollar), EIA (oil, gas, gasoline), FiscalData (Treasury debt daily since 1993, monthly receipts/outlays/deficit, average interest rates). One row = one observation, as published; see unit. Mortgage rates, Moody's corporate bond yields and University of Michigan consumer sentiment are NOT carried: their owners license them, and we do not hold a license. period sorts as text: 2026M04, 2026Q01, 2026A01, 2026W18, 2026D258 (day of year). Deficit values: positive = deficit. More: keyvex.com/docs/tools/get_economic_indicators
